title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: locking down IsolatedStorage reads.
summary: Starting with runtime version 18.0, the IsolatedStorage.Get method accepts an optional IsolationLevel parameter to prevent race conditions during concurrent read-modify-write operations. The new UpdLock isolation level holds an update lock on a key's row during reads, blocking other sessions until the transaction completes, protecting sensitive data like secret keys, feature flags, and cached tokens from concurrent corruption.
key_points: IsolatedStorage.Get now accepts an optional IsolationLevel parameter to control how the key row is locked during reads
IsolationLevel::UpdLock holds an update lock until the transaction ends, preventing other sessions from reading or writing the same key
This protects read-modify-write patterns commonly used for secret keys, feature flags, and cached tokens
Available in runtime version 18.0 and later; earlier versions require alternative locking strategies

quotes.text: two sessions read the same key at the same time, both compute a new value, and one of them silently overwrites the other.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the core race condition problem that the new feature solves
